description: Policy comes from Merkleye/renovate-config through org inheritance. This file only stops Renovate opening an onboarding PR. Keeping the action pins in this repo current is the whole point of letting Renovate near it -- a stale pin here is a stale pin in every repo that calls these workflows.

packageRules.description: This repo's references to itself stay on @main. They are not a dependency -- they are one commit reading its own siblings, and a workflow must run the actions from the commit it was read from. Pinning them to a digest makes every merge here produce a Renovate PR that only re-pins the previous merge, forever.
